crossRefs.note: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,

translations.web: Only on this condition will we consent to you. If you will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised,
translations.bsb: We will consent to this on one condition, that you become circumcised like us—every one of your males.
translations.kjv: But in this will we consent unto you: If ye will be as we be, that every male of you be circumcised;
translations.asv: Only on this condition will we consent unto you: if ye will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised;
